item.statement: A meth overdose can look like a body in overdrive, with a racing heart and fast breathing.
item.why: Two reviews of hospital studies describe a racing heart, fast breathing, wide pupils and great restlessness; some people lose touch with reality. How often each sign shows up varies a lot.

item.statement: Reviews rank MDMA with antidepressants like moclobemide as the riskiest mix they list.
item.why: Four young people in Finland died with MDMA and moclobemide in their blood, and pathologists called each death an accidental poisoning with the two drugs. Four deaths can't give a rate, and all four also had other drugs.
